refactor-plan.argument: cache_layer and lookup_engine currently share one process; splitting them lets the cache be swapped out without touching the authoritative lookup.
refactor-plan.scope: subcomparch's own process boundary only; no change to either subcomponent's public surface.
refactor-plan.rationale: cache_layer's own stubbed-grade declaration already commits to it being removable, and today it isn't, cleanly, because they share a process.
